scripts.web: node -e "const http=require('http'), fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); http.createServer((req,res)=>{ let f = req.url === '/' ? '/index.html' : req.url; let p = path.join(__dirname, f); if(fs.existsSync(p)){ res.writeHead(200); fs.createReadStream(p).pipe(res); } else { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found'); } }).listen(3000, ()=>console.log('Web running at http://localhost:3000'));"
